subject: Life Skills
title: Microfiber Versus Paper Towels
description: A 60-second lesson on Microfiber Versus Paper Towels.

hook.text: A single microfiber cloth can replace up to 60 rolls of paper towels over its lifetime.

buildup.text: Paper towels smear grease and leave lint. Microfiber's tiny fibers trap dirt instead of pushing it.

discovery.text: Microfiber works with just water because the fibers are split fine enough to grab bacteria mechanically.

twist.text: Fabric softener clogs microfiber pores and ruins its cleaning power. Wash with detergent only.

climax.text: Keep separate colors for kitchen, bathroom, and glass. It prevents cross-contamination simply.

punchline.text: One cloth, water, and a color code. Done.
